name: tsmonitor-agent-sidecar
description: AI sidecar for TServerMonitor: talks to the model through the Vercel AI SDK, tools run in the Rust daemon

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/sidecar.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
